name: 结算资金流：DB批量校验（verify_settlement.py 全量回归）
description: 使用 scripts/verify_settlement.py 对钉钉表格中全部29个测试样本进行DB级结算金额校验。覆盖4大阶段×8种路径组合：补贴前取消(7)→补贴后终止(10)→到期确收(6)→到期退款(6)。验证维度：total_amount、init_allowance_amount、serv_finish_refund_amount、settle_status、下架率计算。

steps.command: cd '{workspace}' && echo '=== 补贴前取消(7) ===' && for id in 200000369 200000366 200000382 200000368 200000377 200000378 200000370; do python3 scripts/verify_settlement.py $id 2>&1 | tail -5; echo '---'; done
steps.description: Phase 1: 补贴前取消场景批量校验
Phase 2: 补贴后终止场景批量校验

steps.command: cd '{workspace}' && echo '=== 到期确收(6) ===' && for id in 200000347 200000353 200000345 200000389 200000386 200000387; do python3 scripts/verify_settlement.py $id 2>&1 | tail -5; echo '---'; done
steps.description: Phase 3: 到期确收场景批量校验

steps.command: cd '{workspace}' && echo '=== 到期退款(6) ===' && for id in 200000346 200000352 200001005 200000388 200000385 200000885; do python3 scripts/verify_settlement.py $id 2>&1 | tail -5; echo '---'; done
steps.description: Phase 4: 到期退款场景批量校验

steps.command: cd '{workspace}' && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys; results=sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/settlement_result_*.json')); fail=[]; ok=[]; [fail.append(f'{json.load(open(f)).get("apply_id","?")}: {json.load(open(f)).get("issues",[])}') if [i for i in json.load(open(f)).get('issues',[]) if 'protect_expire_time' not in i] else ok.append(json.load(open(f)).get('apply_id','?')) for f in results]; print(f'PASS: {len(ok)} / FAIL: {len(fail)} / TOTAL: {len(results)}'); [print(f'  FAIL: {f}') for f in fail]; sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)"
steps.description: Phase 5: 汇总所有校验结果（排除时间反挂的数据问题）

post_asserts.command: cd '{workspace}' && python3 -c "import json,glob; results=sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/settlement_result_*.json')); assert len(results)>=28, f'expected>=28, got {len(results)}'; print(f'OK: {len(results)} reports')"
post_asserts.description: 确认所有29个样本都产出了校验报告

_testDesign.preconditions: dms-alibaba CLI 可连接 scenario/prod，所有29个专利申请测试数据已预埋
riskPoints: 4阶段全量覆盖：补贴前(7)→补贴后(10)→到期确收(6)→到期退款(6)
补贴路径分叉：有/无补贴 × 首发/非首发 = 4种金额组合
到期日取早：min(确认一致性+180天, 申请日+1年-30天)
_testDesign.prdRef: 钉钉提测单 gvNG4YZ7Jnxop15OCqPbBaAyW2LD0oRE + PRD 淘天服饰原创保护平台-结算及电子用印
_testDesign.scriptRef: scripts/verify_settlement.py v3（基于PRD+技术方案权威规则）
